title: Raw lizard quoted as the complexity check
cluster_summary: Five addons still quote the raw lizard command in reader-facing docs: suite tables in docs/automated-tests/README.md, docs/testing.md, DEPENDENCIES.md setup blocks and, in MultiMeters, docs/performance.md. automated-tests-§3 (MUST) and anti-pattern #92 require every quoted gate line to be the runner, 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity'. The standard already states this rule, so no upstream change is needed and each fix is a per-repo docs edit. Frozen superpowers plans that quote raw lizard are historical and stay untouched. Fix all five as cheap 'should' items. MultiMeters also pins lizard==1.24.0, which breaks the documentation-§7 MUST, and the standard's own text rebuts the pin's stated rationale, so un-pin it. An optional follow-up outside this cluster: Ka0sAddonsCommonTasks/CLAUDE.md:87 quotes the same raw line, and a dev-copilot sync-docs/revendor-standards check could flag raw 'lizard -l lua' in non-frozen docs.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: docs/automated-tests/README.md:29 quotes blind raw lizard without -L 1500, which contradicts docs/testing.md and DEPENDENCIES.md:98 (that line correctly describes the raw invocation as what runs inside the shadow). This breaks the automated-tests-§3 MUST and costs one line to fix.
verdicts.remediation: Replace the README.md:29 command cell with 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity' (optionally noting that it runs lizard -L 1500 over the sighted shadow). Leave the frozen docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-04-ccn-elimination.md alone.

verdicts.assessment: Verified, with one location missed: the same cell appears word for word at docs/testing.md:283 and docs/automated-tests/README.md:26. Both cells already mention the sighted shadow and -L 1500, but the copyable code span is still the raw command, which is a partial breach of automated-tests-§3.
verdicts.remediation: In both docs/testing.md:283 and docs/automated-tests/README.md:26, make 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity' the command, and keep the lizard -L 1500 line only as a note on what the runner runs inside the shadow.

verdicts.assessment: Verified, with one location missed: DEPENDENCIES.md:136/140 and also docs/automated-tests/README.md:28 quote blind raw lizard as the complexity/release check. docs/testing.md:257 is compliant.
verdicts.remediation: Change DEPENDENCIES.md:136 to 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity --no-bundle   # complexity (release gate)' and reword :140 to 'the complexity suite'. Replace the docs/automated-tests/README.md:28 cell with 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity'.

verdicts.assessment: Raw-command half verified at DEPENDENCIES.md:98 and docs/automated-tests/README.md:38, plus a missed location at docs/performance.md:393 (§4 Complexity code block). The pin is verified at DEPENDENCIES.md:35/58/68-70. documentation-§7 (MUST) says lizard stays 'any recent' precisely because parity catches reader changes, which rebuts the pin's rationale, so the pin is a breach to fix and not an owner call.
verdicts.remediation: Replace the raw lizard command at DEPENDENCIES.md:98 (use '--suite complexity --no-bundle'), docs/automated-tests/README.md:38 and docs/performance.md:393 with 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity'. Un-pin lizard: set :35 to 'any recent (verified with 1.24.0)', change :58 to 'pipx install lizard', and replace the :68-70 rationale with the documentation-§7 parity sentence. Raise a register row only if the owner explicitly wants to keep the pin.

verdicts.assessment: Verified: docs/automated-tests/README.md:29 quotes blind raw lizard without -L 1500 and contradicts docs/testing.md:242. This breaks the automated-tests-§3 MUST, and the fix is one docs cell.
verdicts.remediation: Replace the README.md:29 cell with 'bash tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity' plus the sighted-shadow note from docs/testing.md:242.
